description: Checkmyguest offers you this modern 84 m² apartment on the 1st floor, Rue Saint-Laurent, 75010 Paris, ideal for 8 people. Combining contemporary design, comfort and central location, it promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of the capital.The spaceDiscover this magnificent 84 m² apartment, ideally located on the 1st floor of a Parisian building, accessible by staircase. Designed to accommodate up to 8 people, this space combines modernity, comfort and practicality, perfect for your stays with family or friends.From the moment you enter, you'll be seduced by the contemporary design and meticulous finishes that give this apartment a warm, elegant atmosphere. This location allows you to explore Paris using easily accessible public transport and discover the city's various emblematic sites: the Sacré Coeur, La Tour-Eiffel, Jardin des Tuileries, Palais Garnier, Les Champs-Élysées...This charming apartment comprises :- A superb living room with a magnificent sofa bed, TV, dining table and side table. - An open, functional kitchenette: fridge, freezer, toaster, coffee machine, kettle, microwave, oven... - Three bedrooms, each with a Queen-size bed and closet.- A bathroom with shower, washbasin and separate toilet.- A second shower room with shower, washbasin and separate toilet.- A shower room with shower and washbasin.- A washing machine and tumble dryer for your convenience.- The apartment is air-conditioned.- Plenty of storage space,- TV and broadband Internet access (WiFi),- Bed linen and towels provided.- Bed linen and towels provided.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment.Other things to noteThis booking is protected by coverage for lost luggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Swift Travel Cover, with reimbursement up to 750 euros (T&C
